description: Fixed solar-calendar public holidays of a Jalali year (Nowruz 1-4 Farvardin, 12-13 Farvardin, 14-15 Khordad, 22 Bahman, 29 Esfand) with Gregorian dates, plus the Hijri-based holiday list WITHOUT dates. Lunar holidays shift yearly and need the official annual calendar.
